Wang 2014 Nature, single nucleus genome+exome. Legacy SRA* accession, same caveat as above.
Gao 2016 Nat Genet, punctuated copy number evolution (DOP-PCR). Cited as a comparison set by the Navin lab.
Gawad 2014 PNAS, acute lymphoblastic leukaemia single cells.
